title: ModServe: Modality- and Stage-Aware Resource Disaggregation for Scalable Multimodal Model Serving
authors: Haoran Qiu; Anish Biswas; Zihan Zhao; Jayashree Mohan; Alind Khare; Esha Choukse; Íñigo Goiri; Zeyu Zhang; Haiying Shen; Chetan Bansal; Ramachandran Ramjee; Rodrigo Fonseca
research_focus: Multimodal serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Datacenter networking, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Existing monolithic LMM serving systems suffer from resource contention and inefficient scaling because they tightly couple heterogeneous inference stages (preprocessing, encoding, and LLM backend) that have different performance characteristics. This leads to head-of-line blocking and poor tail latency under bursty multimodal workloads.
problem_statement.zh: 現有單體式 LMM serving 系統將前處理、編碼與 LLM 後端等效能特性各異的異構推理階段緊耦合，導致資源爭用與擴展效率低落，在突發多模態工作負載下出現 head-of-line blocking 與尾延遲惡化。

key_innovation.en: ModServe, a modular LMM serving architecture that decouples image-specific (preprocessing/encoding) and text-specific (LLM prefill/decode) inference stages into independent instances, enabling stage-aware autoscaling, modality-aware request routing, and parallelized image encoding.
key_innovation.zh: ModServe 是一個模組化 LMM serving 架構，將影像專屬（前處理/編碼）與文字專屬（LLM prefill/decode）推理階段解耦為獨立實例，從而支援階段感知自動擴展、模態感知請求路由與並行化影像編碼。

key_improvements.en: 3.3–5.5x higher throughput, 25–41.3% cost reduction, and improved P99 TTFT SLO attainment.
key_improvements.zh: 吞吐量提升 3.3–5.5x，成本降低 25–41.3%，P99 TTFT SLO 達成率顯著改善。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multimodal Model Serving, Image-Text-to-Text, Video-Text-to-Text
traffic_pattern: All-to-All, Pipeline Parallelism, Elephant flows, Concurrent flows
transport_and_interconnect: RDMA, GPU Direct RDMA, TCP/IP, Ethernet
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system paper; reports throughput / cost / P99 TTFT SLO attainment rather than predictive error)
models_validated: LLaVA-1.5-7B, LLaVA-OneVision, InternVL, Qwen-VL (Azure production multimodal traces)
downstream_use: Capacity planning, Scheduling, Autoscaling, SLO admission

scope_assumptions.en: Modality- and stage-aware empirical characterization on Azure production multimodal traffic; decouples image-specific preprocessing/encoding and text-specific LLM prefill/decode stages into independent instances; performance model is *not* published as a closed-form TTFT/TPOT analytical formula — Cornserve / Cornfigurator subsequently fills that gap with a Monte-Carlo planner.
scope_assumptions.zh: 在 Azure 生產多模態流量上進行 modality 與 stage 感知的實證刻畫；將影像專屬的前處理與編碼，以及文字專屬的 LLM prefill/decode 階段，解耦為獨立實例；其效能模型並未以 closed-form 的 TTFT/TPOT 解析公式形式發表 — 此空缺隨後由 Cornserve / Cornfigurator 透過 Monte-Carlo planner 填補。
